question: Can a native context-dependent margin-gated expert arbiter improve held-out binary causal-edge prediction over the strongest equally informed expert and simpler global arbitration?
hypothesis: On independently seeded shifted synthetic environments, the contextual native referee will reduce Brier loss by at least 5% relative to every nonprivileged comparator, with a positive 95% paired-bootstrap improvement over the single interventional expert and global learned gating.

predecessor_evidence.note: CKAD18 synthetic experiments, separately owned; no code/seed reuse
CEA methodology inspiration only, not a replication

inputs.name: Procedural SCM binary X->Y with latent binary U, observed noisy proxy Z, passive and do samples
inputs.source: Generator is in experiment.py, SHA-256 here is source file identity, no external dataset

seeds.prospective_heldout: 61001..61256 inclusive (256 worlds; outcomes not yet inspected)

frozen_design.split: Train and exploratory cohorts are already consumed; ONLY 61001..61256 is prospective, using shifted confounding, proxy reliability, effect strength and intervention counts. No historical first-use or protected research source.
frozen_design.ordering: Train fixed native context-category expert reliability from training labels, freeze weights, evaluate prospective heldout once; same observations/interventions for all arms; no heldout feedback to weights.
frozen_design.data_budget: 256 train worlds, 256 heldout worlds; 90-140 observational samples plus 16-48 do-intervention samples per world; 4 SCM regimes, balanced causal-edge sampling in expectation.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Single local CPU test, 2000 paired bootstrap draws per baseline using fixed hash-seeded Python random; no GPU, paid APIs or owner runner.
frozen_design.capacity: 3 fixed expert functions (observational, interventional, proxy-adjusted), 3-feature context category, fixed eta=12.0, shrinkage=20.0, margin half-width=0.20.
frozen_design.evaluator: YNCA-01 experiment.py frozen source SHA-256 a5a3d489c1f5732728fc5809e44c9b4b7234eb24e281975926cdc97ad128a0d0; Brier loss, edge accuracy, gate calls, deterministic 2000-draw paired bootstrap.

controls: Best raw expert and fixed individual observations
Global learned gate trained on identical labels
metrics: 95% paired bootstrap gain in Brier versus interventional, global gate and equal

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED only if heldout learned_gate Brier <=0.95 * minimum Brier of all nonprivileged expert/ensemble controls; 95% paired-bootstrap gain lower bound >0 against both interventional and global_gate; shuffled_gate Brier at least 0.005 higher; all audits pass. Does not imply SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native integration.
classification_rules.mixed: Learned gate improves equal weighting, but not every strongest nonprivileged control and/or bootstrap support is absent. DEVELOPMENT_MIXED, no promotion.
classification_rules.negative: Learned gate does not improve strongest equally informed control or loses to global-gate on heldout; DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO, preserve falsification.
classification_rules.invalid: Heldout inspection prior to this prereg, split leakage, source mismatch, broken deterministic audit, or missing comparator => INVALID; do not rescue by retuning.

preregistration_note: This prereg ONLY covers new prospective heldout seeds 61001..61256. Earlier 41001/51001 cohorts were exploratory and their outcomes were inspected before this commit; cannot count as confirmatory. No SCIENTIFIC_PASS from synthetic contributor evidence.
